svg.text: Clamp points: one end of BOTH belts goes into the left X carriage half, one into the upper slot and one into the lower, teeth facing the front of the machine (Step 07.9); both tails are captured by the right half (Step 07.24). Lane spacing inside each drive unit is schematic — the chapter fixes the order of the wraps, not their top-view coordinates.
